new: Less work in the background: pages outside a shared room no longer run the room's frame loop, and focus mode runs its own only while it is on and a story shows.
In a headset with no spaceship flying, the spaceships cost nothing each frame; the sound effects move their listener only while a sound placed in the room plays.
A room's alignment is worked out once a frame, not twice; out of a room, the places of rooms you left on purpose are no longer looked for, so no Join offer comes for them.
Story panels in a headset check for changes a little less often per frame, and a few hidden see-through layers (Back into the cell's spaces, the qubits story's grid) are no longer drawn.
The microanatomy story's hierarchy draws its organs with the lighter models, as the atlas does.
Still to try from v214 to v216: the limited menu and the staff unlock, Subtitles per headset, and the hands' turn.
test: The spaceship: launch with the right stick's double click, fly, land, and launch again after a minute with nothing flying.
Focus mode on a phone: subtitles and chapter titles fade in and out, the Sound button and its icon follow the sound, More closes when the bar has room.
A shared room's alignment: walk into a circle, the room lines up and stays put.
Headset panels of any story still redraw at once on a press; Back into the cell's walls chapter; the qubits story's pairs chapter; the microanatomy hierarchy's organs.
v214: the limited menu in a room and the 2-second hold on both sticks. v215: Subtitles in one headset's menu leaves the other as it was. v216: hands ahead and held up, in the mirror and in a room.
untested: Everything in a headset: the spaceship's launch, the room's alignment and places, the sound effects' direction, the panels' redraws.
v214: the limited menu and the unlock in a headset. v215: Subtitles per headset and the room's default. v216: the hands' turn against a real controller.
v213 and earlier as before: nothing since v200 has been in a headset; every synthetic voice is unheard.
